record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: AVALUGG, BERGMITE and HISUI_AVALUGG (the queued units; the only units declaring MOUNTAIN_GALE in the catalog). The AVALUGG passive is only cited for the first-cast Bergmite bonus.

dispatch.note: process calls super.process(..., preventDefaultAnim = true), so the default cast animation is not broadcast; each hit broadcasts its own ability animation

record.summary: Delayed multi-hit flurry: every hit picks one random enemy from the enemies adjacent to the caster at cast time (the cast target is always included), 200 ms x hit index later flinches it for 3000 ms (requested) and deals 40 raw SPECIAL damage. Hit count by caster stars: 1 / 3 / 5 / 10 (10 fallback); on the caster's very first cast of the fight, AVALUGG and HISUI_AVALUGG add one extra hit per BergmiteOnBack stack, capped at 4. BERGMITE never gets the bonus.

targeting.who: enemies in the 8 cells around the caster (center excluded) captured at cast time, plus the cast target if it is not among them (or if there is none adjacent); each hit independently picks one of them uniformly at random with replacement, so one enemy may take several hits and the target list is not refreshed when it moves or dies

geometry.shape: adjacent ring (radius 1, 8 cells) around the caster, evaluated once at cast time

declaredRaw.note: requested damage per hit: 40, fixed, no stat scaling in the strategy

effects.scaling: requested amount: 40 per hit; inside handleSpecialDamage each hit is x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true), x2 if DOUBLE_DAMAGE (the effect is deleted after the first hit that consumes it), x1.2 steam effect, and the crit multiplier only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false: needs ABILITY_CRIT); the crit flag is fixed at cast time and used for every hit
effects.resolution: applied amount per hit: then the target's SPE_DEF division (damage / (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF)) and later handleDamage modifiers; a target with protect / skydiving / magicBounce blocks that hit (death false); if the target has a shield, flinch halves the damage that the shield absorbs (the other half goes on to health); the hit runs 200 ms x i after the cast (hit 0 after the next command update) as a DelayedCommand stored on the caster, and its death/takenDamage results are ignored; whether a picked enemy that has already died by then still receives the status and damage was not traced

effects.condition: only when pokemon.count.ult === 0 before super.process increments it, i.e. the caster's first cast

declaredRaw.formula: min(MaxTroopersPerPkm[pokemon.name] ?? 0, stacks of the caster's BergmiteOnBackEffect ?? 0)
declaredRaw.note: requested extra hits; BERGMITE is not in MaxTroopersPerPkm and has no such effect, so it gets 0

effects.scaling: none: each extra hit is a normal 40-damage hit as above
effects.resolution: stacks = number of Bergmite on the player's board with positionY === 0 (bench row) other than the caster, counted once when the caster spawns (OnSpawnEffect); 0 if the entity has no player; extra hits are added to nbHits in the same loop and their ability animation uses delay i - nbHits

effects.target: the picked enemy of each hit
effects.resolution: applied only if the target lacks runeProtect; the stored duration is the requested 3000 reduced by applyStatusDurationReductions evaluated on the CALLER-supplied entity: mountain-gale passes the caster (pokemon) as the pkm argument, so SWIFT_SWIM (x0.7) / HYDRATION (x0.5) / WATER_VEIL or SURGE_SURFER (x0.3) and the owner's ODD_KEYSTONE count (x(1 - 0.1 n)) of the CASTER shorten it, not the target's; a longer existing flinch is kept; its combat effect in handleDamage is the shield halving described above (other flinch effects not searched)

statusEffects.duration: 3000 ms requested (reduced by the caster's duration-reduction effects, see the effects entry)

starBehavior.note: hits indexed by the casting entity's stars (pokemon.stars - 1); the 5 and 10 entries are not reached by these units' bare star counts (1, 2, 2). Damage per hit (40) and flinch duration do not depend on stars. maxPP is 100 and range 1 for all three.

record.positionalConditions: The target pool is the enemies adjacent to the caster at cast time; the cast target is added when none is adjacent or when it is not adjacent. Extra Bergmite hits depend on how many Bergmite were on the player's bench row (positionY 0) when the caster spawned, not on the board at cast time.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: Only the first cast of the fight (count.ult === 0) can add Bergmite hits; every later cast uses just the star-based hit count. No modes. Pending hits live in the caster's command list, so overlapping casts queue independently.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: 40 damage per hit, hits 1 / 3 / 5 / 10 by stars (+ up to 4 on the first cast for AVALUGG / HISUI_AVALUGG), flinch 3000 ms per hit. Applied damage per hit = 40 x (1 + AP/100) [x2 first DOUBLE_DAMAGE hit] [x crit factor], then the SPE_DEF division and later handleDamage modifiers; takenDamage (incl. shield damage) is not used. Applied flinch duration = 3000 after the caster's duration reductions, kept only if longer than the target's current flinch; blocked by the target's runeProtect.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (shields, items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection) - only the SPECIAL speDef division, the flinch shield halving and the minimum of 1 were read
